title_zh: 校报先核实食堂关闭传闻

scenario.label_zh: 校报关闭传闻的证据核对
scenario.goal_zh: 指出永久关闭说法缺少依据并安排核对原通知

context_zh: 学生校报编辑 Ava 与 Noah 讨论虚构校园内的一则食堂传闻。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Ava
sentences.text: There’s a rumor that the cafeteria is closing permanently. Should it go on the front page?

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: I’m skeptical. The notice I saw mentioned repairs during one weekend.

sentences.speaker: Ava
sentences.text: The screenshot people are sharing cuts off the dates.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Then the claim needs more scrutiny, not a bigger headline.

sentences.speaker: Ava
sentences.text: I’ll ask the office for the full notice before we write anything.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Yes. Send it to me when it arrives, and we can check the dates together.
